attributes.name: inline_symbol_treatment
attributes.definition: How symbols like registered marks or arrows are rendered in text: as typographic glyphs inline vs. via superscript/other markup.

values.definition: Symbols are plain Unicode glyphs set inline in the text.
Symbols are rendered with superscript or similar markup.

attributes.name: microcopy_voice
attributes.definition: Tone and casing conventions of small UI and supporting text.

values.definition: Warm, conversational tone with sentence-case text.
Clean, error-free, professional copy without a distinctly chatty voice.
Formal tone with title-case or uppercase labels.

attributes.name: separator_and_signoff_style
attributes.definition: Punctuation and emphasis devices used in microcopy, such as separators and signature treatment.

values.definition: Spaced slashes as separators and bold sign-off names.
Pipes, bullets or dots as separators with plain sign-offs.

attributes.name: empty_state_treatment
attributes.definition: How empty-state messages are styled when there is no content to show.

values.definition: A single italic serif line states the absence of content.
Plain upright text states the absence.
Illustration or call-to-action accompanies the empty message.
